question: Will Russia capture Kostyantynivka by December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if, according to the ISW map, Russia captures the Kostyantynivka railroad station located on Pravoberezhna vulytsia by December 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET.

The railroad station will be considered captured if any part of the train station icon is shaded red on the ISW map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) by the resolution date. If the area is not shaded red by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to “No”.

If Russia comes into control of this territory as a result of a negotiated settlement, this will qualify for a 'Yes' resolution, regardless of if it is shaded red in the ISW map. An announcement of a negotiated settlement which gives Russia de jure control will not qualify. Actual control must be established.

Once Russia captures the railroad station, any subsequent loss of control will not be considered towards the resolution of this market.

Train Station Location: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/Kostyantynivka3.jpg

Train Station Location in Kostyantynivka: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/Kostyantynivka2.jpg

Kostyantynivka Location: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/Kostyantynivka1.jpg

Location on Google maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/hZ6ch5jVRvkNFY317

The primary resolution source for this market will be the ISW Ukraine map. If the ISW map is rendered unavailable, information from DeepStateMap (https://deepstatemap.live/) may be used. If information from both the ISW and DeepStateMap are rendered permanently unavailable, a consensus of credible reporting may be used.

Note: Any temporary glitches or errors in the map which will not be considered.
research:
I couldn't confirm the deciding fact: whether any part of the station icon is shaded red on ISW's map as of 2026-07-29. Every page fetch was refused by the proxy, including the ISW assessments, so everything below comes from search-result summaries. Several results were dated after 2026-07-29. I left those out.

## 1. Resolution source
- I could not view the ISW StoryMap, and I found no report on whether it shades the station red as of 2026-07-29.
- 2026-07-12: ISW cited analyst Kostiantyn Mashovets saying Russian forces "advanced north of the Kostyantynivka railway station" and had a foothold in eastern Kostyantynivka (Teatralna to Bulgakov Street, and along Minska Street). These are his claims, not ISW-confirmed control. A related note says Ukrainian forces still held the Pravoberezhna industrial area, which is the station's street. [ISW/CTP July 12](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-july-12-2026)
- 2026-06-10/11: ISW, again citing Mashovets, said Russian groups had reached the station area from the T-0504 road and from the southwest, but "have so far failed to seize the railway station." [Euromaidan Press](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/06/11/isw-russia-gains-ground-in-kostiantynivka-but-fortress-belt-stays-out-of-reach/), [NV](https://english.nv.ua/russian-war/russian-forces-make-tactical-gains-in-kostiantynivka-after-missing-may-deadline-50615261.html)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing found settles the question. The latest reports have Russian infiltrators near and north of the station, with ISW still describing the city as contested. In mid-July the July 31 contract traded at 41% while the December 31 contract was about 95% (section 5). That gap suggests traders did not think the station was already shaded red.
- 2026-07-29: ISW said the situation in and near Kostyantynivka is getting worse, but Russian forces have not taken the city despite Russian claims. It expects several more weeks of fighting as Russia tries to hold ground won by infiltration, helped by glide-bomb strikes. [ISW/CTP July 29](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-july-29-2026), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/81364)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-29: ISW reported that geolocated footage from July 27 showed a Russian advance in western Kostyantynivka and that infiltration missions were continuing. Footage from July 28 showed Ukrainian strikes on Russians in central Kostyantynivka after an infiltration. [Euromaidan Press](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/07/29/russia-is-bombing-kostiantynivka-to-rubble-while-pushing-its-infantry-into-it-on-foot/)
- Mid to late July: DeepState said Russia was pushing into the city by infiltration, that Ukrainian logistics were hard because of Russian air superiority, and that Ukraine should reject a Russian offer of a half-day halt to strikes in the city. [Suspilne](https://suspilne.media/donbas/1347892-kategoricno-ne-mozna-pogodzuvatisa-deepstate-pro-propoziciu-rf-pripiniti-udari-u-kostantinivci/), [Novosti Donbasu](https://novosti.dn.ua/news/66346-u-deepstate-rozpovily-pro-sytuacziyu-u-kostyantynivczi-ta-nazvaly-golovne-zavdannya-rosijskyh-vijsk/)
- 2026-07-18: ISW said Russian infiltration continued with no confirmed advances. A Ukrainian regiment reported a clearing operation and said it controls the city. [ISW/CTP July 18](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-july-18-2026)
- 2026-07-05: DeepState said Russia does not control Kostyantynivka and fighting continues in the city and on its outskirts. [Realgazeta](https://realgazeta.com.ua/okupanti-nie-kontroliuiut-kostiantinivku-u-misti-ta-na-iogho-okolitsiakh-trivaiut-boyi-deepstate/)
- 2026-07-03: Putin said Russia had seized the city. ISW said the evidence contradicts this, and Zelensky called it a lie. [ISW/CTP July 3](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-july-3-2026), [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/will-russia-capture-kostyantynivka-polymarket-odds)
- 2026-07-01: ISW called Kostyantynivka Russia's main effort for spring-summer 2026, with tactical gains in June. [ISW/CTP July 1](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-july-1-2026)
- June 2026: Ukrainian commanders told hromadske that 100 to 250 Russian troops had entered the city center. [NV](https://english.nv.ua/russian-war/russian-groups-breach-kostyantynivka-center-50615696.html)

## 4. Base rates
- The battle has run since late October 2025. Around the end of December 2025, Russian forces reached the T-0504 highway in eastern Kostyantynivka and began moving along Ostrovskoho Street toward the station. More than 7 months later, the station had still not been confirmed taken. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Kostiantynivka)
- Russia missed a reported May 2026 deadline to take the city. [ua.news](https://ua.news/en/war-vs-rf/rf-ne-zmogla-zakhopiti-kostiantinivku-do-travnia-isw)
- Comparable sieges of large Donbas towns (Bakhmut, Avdiivka, Pokrovsk) usually ended within months once Russia had a foothold in the city and the defenders' logistics were degraded. I did not find a formal base-rate study for this.
- One caveat: from July 1 to 17, ISW said Russia lost territory at about 1.6 km² per day overall. That reflects Ukraine's 2026 counteroffensive elsewhere, not this sector. [ISW/CTP July 18](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-july-18-2026)

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-07-12: Polyguana showed the December 31 station contract at 95%. [Polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/677366)
- 2026-07-13: The July 31 station contract traded at 41%. It had jumped from about 28% to 62% after Putin's claim, then fell back. [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/will-russia-capture-kostyantynivka-polymarket-odds)
- June 2026: SimpleFunctions showed the December 31 contract at about 80 to 92%. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/odds/russia-capture-kostyantynivka)
- Undated: FutureSearch put capture by June 30 at 16%, noting the strongest Ukrainian defenses were in the east of the city, where the station is. [FutureSearch](https://futuresearch.ai/app/p/a/will-russia-capture-kostyantynivka-by-june-30)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold market. The live market is [here](https://polymarket.com/event/will-russia-capture-kostyantynivka-by).

## 6. Upcoming events
- The question closes 2026-07-29 21:32 UTC. Watch the ISW daily assessments and map updates, especially any geolocated Russian advance on Pravoberezhna vulytsia or the station.
- On 2026-07-29, ISW expected several more weeks of fighting as Russia consolidates.
- Other factors: the 2026 Ukrainian counteroffensive, which could pull Russian resources away; ceasefire talks, including Russia's proposed local halt to strikes; and how ISW treats infiltration zones on its map, since it does not always shade them red.

forecasts.reasoning:
e station area has been contested since about late December 2025 without being taken.
  - Ukraine still held the Pravoberezhna industrial area in mid-July.
  - ISW is conservative and does not shade infiltration zones red.
  - Ukraine's 2026 counteroffensive has Russia losing net territory elsewhere (about 1.6 km² per day, July 1 to 17).
  - Russia missed a reported May deadline.

**(e) Scenarios.**
- No: Ukraine holds the eastern industrial belt around the station, and Russian infiltrators near it are repeatedly cleared. The counteroffensive draws Russian reserves away, so ISW never confirms a Russian position touching the station icon before year end.
- Yes: Through August to October, Russia consolidates its infiltration gains under glide-bomb cover. Geolocated footage then shows Russian troops at or past the station, and ISW shades the area red.

**(f) From base rate to final probability.** I start at about 75% from the base rate. I move up because the bar is low (any part of the icon), Russian troops are already next to and north of the station, and ISW's own outlook on 2026-07-29 was worsening. The liquid market on this exact contract was at about 95%, which pulls toward the high 80s or low 90s. I shade below the market for three reasons: ISW is slow to confirm advances, the station-area fight has dragged on for seven months, and the Ukrainian counteroffensive adds uncertainty. Log scoring also penalizes overconfidence heavily. Net, I land at about 89%.

Probability: 89%

Probability: 86%
